keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Words to search in titles and descriptions, e.g. cybersecurity, janitorial, "cloud migration". Leave empty to list everything that matches the filters.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Empty = all types. Default: open bids and early-stage notices.

setAsides.title: Set-asides
setAsides.description: Keep only notices reserved for these business types. Empty = any.

states.title: Place of performance states
states.description: Two-letter state codes, e.g. TX, VA, DC.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted or updated in the last N days
postedWithinDays.description: 0 = any date. Use 1 on a daily schedule for a feed of new and amended notices.

responseDueWithinDays.title: Responses due in the next N days
responseDueWithinDays.description: Only notices whose response deadline falls between today and N days from now. 0 = any deadline.

activeOnly.title: Active notices only
activeOnly.description: Off includes archived and past notices (useful for award history).

includeDetails.title: Add contacts, NAICS, set-aside and attachments
includeDetails.description: Reads each notice: contracting officer name, email and phone, NAICS and PSC codes, set-aside, place of performance, full description, attachment links and award details. Off = search fields only, faster.

maxResults.title: Maximum notices
maxResults.description: Newest first. SAM.gov returns up to 10,000 per search.
